# Pricing
The Starter plan costs $19 per workspace per month. The Team plan costs $79 per workspace per month.

# Security policy
Customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using AES-256. Security incidents should be reported to security@example.com.

# FAQ
GlassBox is an observable retrieval augmented generation application. It shows context, documents, model calls, token usage, cost, latency, and validation results.
